facts.description: Open-source AI interfaces built with Claude (Fable 5) including hero sections, GLSL shaders, design systems, animations, 3D components  and and landing pages,  in React, Tailwind, and Three.js. Plug them into your AI agent and ship faster.

research.name: claude-directory
research.note: Gallery of about 550 Claude-generated web UI experiments, each folder shipping its source, the originating prompt and a recorded demo.

effects: every project folder ships its originating prompt.md next to a demo.mp4 recording
card stream that turns photos into ASCII text as they cross a glowing scan line
volumetric ray-marched stained-glass shader with switchable light regimes
Three.js particle torus knot behind hero type

unverified: The live directory site was not seen: https://pulkit.page/claude-directory and https://www.pulkit.page/claude-directory both returned HTTP 404, so the gallery browsing UI is unobserved.
Only still poster frames of four projects were viewed; motion and pointer interaction of the effects are taken from the README descriptions.
The project count of about 550 is the sum of the README category headings (41+98+12+2+14+15+34+84+250), not a count of folders.
